script: You’re staring at a ten-dollar churro you didn't want. You didn't plan on buying it. But the park path forced you to weave past every single window. Designers use winding paths to keep you moving. They make sure you pass every shop. You’re just a pawn in their game. And that’s why you’re staring at a ten-dollar churro.
title: Why You Always Buy Stuff You Dont Need At Theme Parks #parks #design #psychology
description: This isn't an accident. Theme parks use winding paths and forced retail displays to increase your time spent walking past food and merchandise. Subscribe for daily explanations of everyday mysteries.
